easyPrerequisites:
Gnostro does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Gnostro.
You have cast at least one spell this turn.
description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Gnostro.
Repeat.
